name: Muirenn Ó Riain
source:
Matriarch of the Ó Riains, [url=https://vndb.org/c146929]Bael[/url] and Éamonn's mother, and [url=https://vndb.org/c170482]Edric[/url]'s wife.

Bael said while her parents are close, their marriage is platonic.

She and [url=https://vndb.org/c170480]Wynne[/url] were the main driving forces behind the recent Ó Riain and Colter partnership.
